This is a tier 4 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Lorminstra
Deity Primary Color:              Pure golden
Deity Secondary Color:            Black
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready
Ardent Plea [RAISE]:              Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.

This idol is an item that holds the spiritual essence of an animal.  The essence can be gained from animal-like creatures, familiars, animal companions, or Animalistic Spirit items.
==Features==
* Spiritual Essences [5 out of 5 Slots Unlocked]
POINT the idol at an appropriate animal-like creature, familiar, animal companion, or Animalistic Spirit item to have the idol absorb some of the creature's essence.
If you have more than one spiritual essence slot unlocked, you can use TURN on the idol to switch between the stored essences.
* Ambient Messages [OFF - PROD to toggle]
While you are wearing the idol, the spiritual essence currently chosen will make itself known every so often with ambient messaging.  You can use PROD to quiet the spirit at any time.
* Animalistic Decoration

You can PUSH Foraged Items, feathers, bones/teeth, skins, and other small items into the idol and change its long description (the portion after the noun only).  Visit any willing merchant to change how each decoration type looks.  You can then PULL the idol to remove the item at any time.

While holding something made of metal, wood, or bone in one hand, you can ADD to the idol to change its base material.  CLEAN it to return it to how it looked initially.  WARNING: Materials used to change the idol's base material are lost forever, so be sure you are happy with what you choose.
* Accent Material Change [Unlocked]

Once unlocked, you can then TWIST the idol to focus on the accent material instead of the base material, allowing ADD to change the idol's article.  You can use CLEAN, as well, while focused on the accent material to return the idol to its original article.
Once an accent material has been added, you can use FLIP to adjust the article to different styles based on that material.
* Movement Styles [Unlocked -] ON in "Animal Shadow" style, use COVER to toggle off.]
When unlocked, you can allow the spiritual essence inside the idol to affect how you look when you move from room to room.  SPIN will select a style, while COVER will toggle the feature off.
* Wear Location Change [Unlocked]
When unlocked, you can use FOLD on the idol to switch between pin, wrist, and neck-worn locations.
* Bestial Power [Unlocked - T5 of 5,] Animalistic Endurance.]  (Flares: OFF, RUB to toggle)
When unlocked, the spiritual essence inside the idol can help you passively in combat.  Only one of four paths can be chosen, and this cannot be changed once unlocked.
Abilities happen at a standard flare rate during combat if there are enough charges available.
Animalistic Endurance (Defensive) - +2 crit padding per tier.
Bestial Block (Defensive) - +3 DS/+2 TD per tier
Shifting Strike (Offensive) - +3 AS/+2 CS per tier
Feral Ferocity (Offensive) - +2 crit weighting per tier
The ability is fueled by skins from creatures, and up to 500 charges can be stored.
* Fluff Actions [Unlocked, T2 of 2.]
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations are fine, though the noun must be "idol", "totem", or "fetish".
* The adjective field should contain the material the idol is made of.
* This idol cannot accept a show description.

* Any willing merchant can change the designs for when feathers, bone/teeth, flowers, gems, bugs/sea creatures, or miscellaneous items are PUSHed into the idol.  These work much like Veolas, but the only part of the description you can customize is the part after the noun.
* Any willing merchant can change the color of the different spiritual essences.
==Usage==

You will find that you can use the following verbs: POINT (attune to a creature), ADD (add a material), PUSH (add a decoration), PULL (remove a current decoration), CLEAN (set material back to default), PROD (toggle ambient messages), TWIST (change between material and accent), FLIP (change accent design once accent is ADDed), TURN (change spiritual essence selected), SPIN (change movement style), COVER (toggle off movement style), FOLD (change wear location), PRAY, WAVE (targeted/untargeted), TOUCH, POKE, DROP/PUT (feed skins), RUB (toggle flares on/off).
You can TOSS the idol at a creature/object to send it in for review as a possible spiritual essence source.

raw: A faint white sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.

Analysis of a sacrosanct golden battle standard with a rippling white sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 5 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Koar
Deity Primary Color:              Golden
Deity Secondary Color:            White
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready
Ardent Plea [RAISE]:              Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

Analysis of a bear-shaped smooth blackened bone idol indicates the creator has provided the following information:
-- Animalistic Totem --
This idol is an item that holds the spiritual essence of an animal.  The essence can be gained from animal-like creatures, familiars, animal companions, or Animalistic Spirit items.
==Features==
* Spiritual Essences [5 out of 5 Slots Unlocked]
POINT the idol at an appropriate animal-like creature, familiar, animal companion, or Animalistic Spirit item to have the idol absorb some of the creature's essence.
If you have more than one spiritual essence slot unlocked, you can use TURN on the idol to switch between the stored essences.
* Ambient Messages [OFF - PROD to toggle]
While you are wearing the idol, the spiritual essence currently chosen will make itself known every so often with ambient messaging.  You can use PROD to quiet the spirit at any time.
* Animalistic Decoration

You can PUSH Foraged Items, feathers, bones/teeth, skins, and other small items into the idol and change its long description (the portion after the noun only).  Visit any willing merchant to change how each decoration type looks.  You can then PULL the idol to remove the item at any time.

While holding something made of metal, wood, or bone in one hand, you can ADD to the idol to change its base material.  CLEAN it to return it to how it looked initially.  WARNING: Materials used to change the idol's base material are lost forever, so be sure you are happy with what you choose.
* Accent Material Change [Unlocked]

Once unlocked, you can then TWIST the idol to focus on the accent material instead of the base material, allowing ADD to change the idol's article.  You can use CLEAN, as well, while focused on the accent material to return the idol to its original article.
Once an accent material has been added, you can use FLIP to adjust the article to different styles based on that material.
* Movement Styles [Unlocked -] ON in "Animal Shadow" style, use COVER to toggle off.]
When unlocked, you can allow the spiritual essence inside the idol to affect how you look when you move from room to room.  SPIN will select a style, while COVER will toggle the feature off.
* Wear Location Change [Unlocked]
When unlocked, you can use FOLD on the idol to switch between pin, wrist, and neck-worn locations.
* Bestial Power [Unlocked - T5 of 5,] Animalistic Endurance.]  (Flares: OFF, RUB to toggle)
When unlocked, the spiritual essence inside the idol can help you passively in combat.  Only one of four paths can be chosen, and this cannot be changed once unlocked.
Abilities happen at a standard flare rate during combat if there are enough charges available.
Animalistic Endurance (Defensive) - +2 crit padding per tier.
Bestial Block (Defensive) - +3 DS/+2 TD per tier
Shifting Strike (Offensive) - +3 AS/+2 CS per tier
Feral Ferocity (Offensive) - +2 crit weighting per tier
The ability is fueled by skins from creatures, and up to 500 charges can be stored.
* Fluff Actions [Unlocked, T2 of 2.]
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations are fine, though the noun must be "idol", "totem", or "fetish".
* The adjective field should contain the material the idol is made of.
* This idol cannot accept a show description.

* Any willing merchant can change the designs for when feathers, bone/teeth, flowers, gems, bugs/sea creatures, or miscellaneous items are PUSHed into the idol.  These work much like Veolas, but the only part of the description you can customize is the part after the noun.
* Any willing merchant can change the color of the different spiritual essences.
==Usage==

You will find that you can use the following verbs: POINT (attune to a creature), ADD (add a material), PUSH (add a decoration), PULL (remove a current decoration), CLEAN (set material back to default), PROD (toggle ambient messages), TWIST (change between material and accent), FLIP (change accent design once accent is ADDed), TURN (change spiritual essence selected), SPIN (change movement style), COVER (toggle off movement style), FOLD (change wear location), PRAY, WAVE (targeted/untargeted), TOUCH, POKE, DROP/PUT (feed skins), RUB (toggle flares on/off).
You can TOSS the idol at a creature/object to send it in for review as a possible spiritual essence source.

This is a tier 5 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Koar
Deity Primary Color:              Golden
Deity Secondary Color:            White
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready
Ardent Plea [RAISE]:              Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

The material may be changed to other types of wood at the merchant's discretion.  Allowed nouns: standard, flag, banner, ensign, pennant, pennon, banderole, banderol, bannerol, oriflamme, and gonfalon. Wehnimer's Landing.name: a sacrosanct pure golden battle standard with a rippling black sheen

raw: A faint black sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct pure golden battle standard with a rippling black sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct pure golden battle standard with a rippling black sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 1 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Lorminstra
Deity Primary Color:              Pure golden
Deity Secondary Color:            Black
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

There will always be a reference to the pole and the banner upon LOOKing at this item.  Please take this into account when composing your show description.  The material may be changed to other types of wood at the merchant's discretion.  Allowed nouns: standard, flag, banner, ensign, pennant, pennon, banderole, banderol, bannerol, oriflamme, and gonfalon.  Finally, any and all alterations will be irreversibly removed if the battle standard is ever converted to another deity in the future.
The battle standard may not be lightened.
The battle standard will cost 2,000,000 coins.

A timeworn location swatch grants the ability to change the worn location of an unscripted, wearable item.
DETAILS:
> Armaments are ineligible, with the exception of greaves.
> DB items, EZ Scripted items, and items with Flourishes are ineligble.
> Arm and leg greaves may only swap between the Arms (14) and Legs (15) locations.
> Only containers can be processed as a container, and they must be empty at the time of redemption.
> Container capacities will not increase (only decrease or be removed).
> Pockets are removed if a container becomes a non-container or is changed to a location that does not
support containers.
> The resulting noun is dictated by the new worn location and original item properties.  Only wood and
metal items can be processed as wood and metal, respectively.
> Locations with only base and container nouns will change non-leather items to cloth.
> Non-leather containers, socks, undershirts, and leggings will be changed to cloth.
> Items that are organic or lacking a material will be handled as non-metal and be changed to cloth,
with the exception of greaves, which default to plain metal.

Miscellany includes other foraged items, skins, shells, and other larger non-gem treasure items.  The cap has several distinct descriptions, depending on what item is inserted.  To insert an item, hold the cap in one hand, the item you'd like to insert in the opposite hand, and PUSH cap.  PULLing the cap will remove the item and restore the cap to its empty description.  It has been fully unlocked and has the following verbs available: TWIST, TAP, ATTEND, NOD and SHAKE.

When worn, it will temporarily alter your hairstyle and supports up to three custom hairstyles in addition to the default setting.  To change between the available hairstyles, hold the item in your hands and TURN it.  Currently it has the following custom hairstyles:
<hair> swept up into a fountain of loose curls beneath a pleated white velvet cap caught with a silken pink bow, his ears tucked beneath the pleated fabric
<hair> left in a shaggy disarray beneath a pleated white velvet cap caught with a silken pink bow
<hair> twirled into a loose bun beneath a pleated white velvet cap caught with a silken pink bow, the hat cocked diagonally upon his head<
<hair> and a pleated white velvet cap caught with a silken pink bow worn at a rakish angle (default)

When altering these items there is some important information to keep in mind.  First, this item belongs to the HAT group and may only be altered in one of the following nouns without changing the group: Hat, Cap, Tricorn, Tricorne, and Capotain.  And while each side is highly customizable, both the noun and material do need to remain the same for all sides.
The sides currently are:
Short: white velvet cap
Gem/Button: a white velvet cap caught with <a/an> <adj>-horned narwhal
Feather: a pleated white velvet cap caught with a spray of <adj>
The white velvet cap will cost 600,000 coins.

Wehnimer's Landing.name: a sacrosanct pure golden battle standard with a rippling black sheen

raw: A faint black sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct pure golden battle standard with a rippling black sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct pure golden battle standard with a rippling black sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 1 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Lorminstra
Deity Primary Color:              Pure golden
Deity Secondary Color:            Black
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

There will always be a reference to the pole and the banner upon LOOKing at this item.  Please take this into account when composing your show description.  The material may be changed to other types of wood at the merchant's discretion.  Allowed nouns: standard, flag, banner, ensign, pennant, pennon, banderole, banderol, bannerol, oriflamme, and gonfalon.  Finally, any and all alterations will be irreversibly removed if the battle standard is ever converted to another deity in the future.
The battle standard may not be lightened.
The battle standard will cost 2,000,000 coins.

Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

Wehnimer's Landing.name: a sacrosanct night black battle standard with a rippling silver sheen

raw: A faint silver sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct night black battle standard with a rippling silver sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct night black battle standard with a rippling silver sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 1 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Ronan
Deity Primary Color:              Night black
Deity Secondary Color:            Silver
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

There will always be a reference to the pole and the banner upon LOOKing at this item.  Please take this into account when composing your show description.  The material may be changed to other types of wood at the merchant's discretion.  Allowed nouns: standard, flag, banner, ensign, pennant, pennon, banderole, banderol, bannerol, oriflamme, and gonfalon.  Finally, any and all alterations will be irreversibly removed if the battle standard is ever converted to another deity in the future.
The battle standard may not be lightened.
The battle standard will cost 1,000,000 coins.

PUT {sphere} [in] MY capsule  - Insert a sphere inside the proper chamber.

raw: The baldric is constructed of layers of storm grey suede and looks like it would be worn cross-torso from shoulder to hip.  Four rows of two faceted glyphs form the baldric's central design, with each ensconced in its own gold setting.  One of the uppermost six glyphs glows a bright blue, while the remaining glyphs in the top three rows are lit by a dim inner light.

Analysis of a gold-stitched storm grey ivory-adorned baldric indicates the creator has provided the following information:

Looking over the baldric and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/ivory-adorned/baldric or yoke".  This means the item's article CAN be changed.  Only "baldric" and "yoke" are valid as nouns, and the adjective of "ivory-adorned" is unalterable.  Also, the allowed wear-locations are shoulder-worn for baldrics and front-worn for yokes.  So if your alteration involves changing the noun, realize the wear-location MUST BE changed also.

NOTE:  The script's description of the baldric refers to it as "Constructed of layers of (color) (material)..." and bearing "...rows of faceted glyphs...," so keep that in mind if you request an alteration.  The material and color of the baldric CAN be changed.  This item cannot accept a SHOW description, since the script already utilizes that field.
The color that the charged glyphs glow CAN be changed.  It must be no longer than fifteen characters.
If you were to play with the ivory-adorned baldric, then you'd find that you can analyze, wear, remove, clench, push, and rub it.  RUB releases/casts a charge previously stored from a white crystal.
This is a Tier 3 baldric, with four tiers in total.  This baldric is sold OTS with one tier unlocked.

Analysis of a mithril framed eisenruck with polished brass panels indicates the creator has provided the following information:

Looking over the eisenruck and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/(whatever)/eisenruck", so the item's article and adjective CAN be changed, but "eisenruck" cannot.
To insert a gem into the eisenruck, you must be wearing the eisenruck and holding a gem in one hand, then PUSH eisenruck.
Note 1:  The eisenruck must be worn continuously for a minimum of one day before any of its gem-eating abilities will function.
Note 2:  When you LOOK at your eisenruck, if a socket is described as "open," then it is ready to have a gem inserted into it.  If a socket is described as "closed," then it is in cooldown.

Wehnimer's Landing.name: a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome

raw: The brass and gold capsule is divided into two halves, with the top portion being crafted from glass and the bottom portion wrought from brass and gold.  Through the transparent glass, ten chambers are exposed inside the capsule, each detailed with a miniature replica of the cities and towns across Elanthia.  A glowing ring surrounds the chamber for Ta'Illistim currently.  It appears that the capsule can hold 20 Chronomage spheres in each chamber.  An enruned opening is situated between both halves of the capsule.  The brass and gold capsule contains no brass and gold spheres in the Ta'Illistim chamber.

This is a container to hold your Chronomage spheres.  The spheres must NOT be attuned to you, used in a waiting room, or have an expirations.  This capsule holds 20 spheres in each chamber.  This can be expanded to hold more by special vouchers or rare merchants that will dabble in such arts.
Usage:
LOOK at MY capsule            - Look at the chambers inside.
PUT {sphere} [in] MY capsule  - Insert a sphere inside the proper chamber.
PUSH MY capsule               - Eject a sphere from inside the capsule.
TURN MY capsule               - Change which chamber it is set to.
RUB MY capsule                - Reveal the contents of each chamber instantly.
The brass and gold capsule will cost 500,000 coins.

Anchored by an embossed hook plate, several finely crafted braided sterling silver chains hold essential tools.  Among them are a mother-of-pearl inlaid scissor sheath and a rose-filigreed silver nail file sheath, ensuring quick access and secure storage.  Dangling from a length of chain is a wren-capped clip that is intended to house a thimble, while a lacquered birch eyeglass case keeps spectacles conveniently within reach.  Additional rings and chains are fashioned to secure a keyring while a small, metallic lobster claw clip is engineered to support a single key.
It is estimated that a silk-pocketed gold chatelaine dangling a petite stylus paired with a tiny notebook can store a fairly small amount with enough space for several items.
The chatelaine can be worn, attaching it to the belt.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of gold, piece of treasure.
Analysis of a silk-pocketed gold chatelaine dangling a petite stylus paired with a tiny notebook indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Fresh from the Coven's Chatelaines.

Designed as both a practical item and a new fashion statement, the chatelaine is a convenient piece of jewelry worn on the waist.  It is crafted from a variety of materials and can be highly customized.
The chatelaine can only hold very specific items and has a maximum capacity of six total items.  It is restricted to holding items with the following nouns:
file, eyeglasses, glasses, key, key ring, scissors, and/or spectacles
Customizations:
Scissor Sheath - a mother-of-pearl inlaid
File Sheath - a rose-filigreed silver
Eyeglass Case - a lacquered birch
Thimble Clip - a wren-capped
Chains - braided sterling silver
Hook Plate - an embossed
Alterations:
* Long Descriptions Only.  It has a stock SHOW.
* Scissor Sheath - You may provide the article and adjective information but it will always be a single scissor sheath.
* File Sheath - You may provide the article and adjective information but it will always be a single file sheath.
* Eyeglass Case - You may provide the article and adjective information but it will always be a single eyeglass case.
* Thimble Clip - You may provide the article and adjective information but it will always be a single thimble clip or clip.
* Chains - These may be plural but will always have a noun of chains.
* Hook Plate - You may provide the article and adjective information but it will always be a single hook plate.
* A silk-pocketed gold chatelaine dangling a petite stylus paired with a tiny notebook cannot be lightened or deepened.
The chatelaine is tier 1 of 2.
A silk-pocketed gold chatelaine dangling a petite stylus paired with a tiny notebook may hold a maximum of 6 individual items.  Some merchants may get it up to 8.  It currently holds 6 items.
The gold chatelaine will cost 100,000 coins.

Wehnimer's Landing.name: a sacrosanct bright silver battle standard with a rippling muted black sheen

raw: A faint muted black sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct bright silver battle standard with a rippling muted black sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct bright silver battle standard with a rippling muted black sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 5 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Zelia
Deity Primary Color:              Bright silver
Deity Secondary Color:            Muted black
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready
Ardent Plea [RAISE]:              Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

There will always be a reference to the pole and the banner upon LOOKing at this item.  Please take this into account when composing your show description.  The material may be changed to other types of wood at the merchant's discretion.  Allowed nouns: standard, flag, banner, ensign, pennant, pennon, banderole, banderol, bannerol, oriflamme, and gonfalon.  Finally, any and all alterations will be irreversibly removed if the battle standard is ever converted to another deity in the future.
The battle standard may not be lightened.
The battle standard will cost 8,000,000 coins.

This item allows you to transfer its appearance onto another compatible worn item by using the TRANSFER verb.  Hold this item in one hand and the target item in your other.  You must repeat the command within 30 seconds to confirm.
Rules:
- Both items must be worn in the same location
- Both items must either be containers or both be non-containers
- If this item is a container, it must be empty before transfer
- The source item is destroyed after a successful transfer
- If the target item has a script, it must be one approved for transmogrification
You may also use CLEAN to remove this script from the item, or use DUST to remove its long description, turning it into a thick buckskin backpack.
You might be able to have a talented merchant lighten the buckskin backpack for you or deepen its pockets.
The buckskin backpack will cost 6,000 coins.

raw: This stunning nautilus shell ocarina is a genuine nautilus shell, a masterpiece of nature's design.  Its elegantly spiraled form showcases a series of smooth, flowing curves that taper gracefully to a point, embodying the delicate balance of oceanic beauty.  The shell glimmers in a soft light peach hue, reminiscent of sun-kissed coral, with subtle pearlescent undertones that shift gently with movement.  Intricate ridges spiral outward from the center, creating a mesmerizing pattern that draws the eye, while the polished exterior reflects hints of the surrounding landscape like a serene mirror.  Its organic texture and natural sheen evoke the mysteries of the sea, making it not just an instrument but a striking piece of coastal artistry.
The nautilus shell ocarina requires skill in woodwind instruments to play effectively.
The nautilus shell ocarina must be played with two hands.
The ocarina can be worn around the neck.

Analysis of a pearlescent nautilus shell ocarina suspended on a clinch knot cord indicates the creator has provided the following information:

Hello, intrepid player!  This nautilus shell ocarina is a prize from the Undergrowth of Biitermere Woods (Ebon Gate).  When worn, it has a chance to summon a Luukosian lanternbearer after you slay a creature.  When the lanternbearer is slain, the ocarina has a 0% chance to grant an attack, defense, or regenerative boon.  Further, it has a 30% chance to generate a phylactery that can be CLENCH'd to either regain 1-3 spirit or extend one of the boons by 30 seconds, with a 1 hour cooldown.
SETTINGS
Attuned : No one
Charges : 0
Dirge of the Lanternbearer : off
Soulbound Crescendo : 0
Illusion Setting : off, Option 1 - Radiating from the spiral-like lines of the nautilus shell ocarina that drapes from his neck, a pale light surrounds Brodega in a pearlescent aura.
VERBS
cover : Toggles the illusion effect on and off.  Currently: off
raise : Toggles Dirge of the Lanternbearer on and off.  Currently: off
turn : Selects the next illusion or you may "turn ocarina to [1-7]" to select a specific one.  Currently: 1
RP verbs : exhale, breathe, gasp, hum, push, whisper, yell
ALTERATIONS
This item may be freely altered, but it must remain an ocarina in both form and function.  It cannot be in a condition where it cannot play music (e.g. must be in good, working condition).
The nautilus shell ocarina will cost 35,000,000 coins.

Analysis of a ruffle-wing moth greatcloak of peacock blue spidersilk indicates the creator has provided the following information:
~*~ Moth Cloaks ~*~

This greatcloak is a butterfly/moth cloak with several randomizing points to create multiple unique looks with a single PUSH.  It is Tier 5 out of 5, it has has the "side-unlock" for a temp feature alter + choosing your color, and it is set to the moth setting.  It is set to NOT rotate with day/night changes.  You can APPROVE to toggle this setting.
The greatcloak features an encumbrance reduction (3x/day, 15 minutes each RUB, resets at midnight server time.  There are 3 charges left today.
Utilities:
* APPROVE:  rotates through "moth only," "butterfly only," or "adjust with day/night"
* ATTEND - shows the temporary feature options
* CLEAN:  will clear the selected, stored look
* FIDGET - shows the colors available to permanently set for the forewings on randomized looks
* POKE: takes your randomized look and saves it in 1 of the 2 available stored slots
* PUSH - replaces your randomized look
* TURN - rotates through all saved looks (current randomized look, any stored randomized looks, the custom look, if applicable)
* RUB - activates the encumbrance reduction.
* WHISPER - allows you to set the temporary feature option and the forewing color
Unlocked Fluff Verbs:  observe, tickle, eat, flip, hug, raise, bow, curtsy, brush, touch, and wave
*  WAVE has some "drama llama" options for you!  Try WAVE CLOAK WITH (anger, drama, joy, mystery, or sorrow)
Alterations:
* Base:  must be simple, as it carries across all looks.  The noun must be in the hooded cloak family.
* Material:  must be a type of cloth.  This carries across all looks.
* Colors cannot be referenced in the base or material fields, as colors change based on the settings.
* Custom settings:  The alter points must be provided in this specific order:

** "butterfly adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing markinglocation^special*moth adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing marking location^special
** The total character count must be 511 or less
** Moth/Butterfly Adjective alter point must be 15 characters or less.  No a/an needed.
** See the wiki for in-depth information and examples at https://gswiki.play.net/Moth_Cloak
* Custom Look 1 (Butterfly):  You can provide a SHOW for your custom setting.  It cannot contradict the alter points selected for the custom settings.
* Custom Look 2 (Moth):  Same as butterfly, but for the moth version.

* Doing a custom setting is 1 alteration service, as is each custom look (so a custom setting, butterfly look, and moth look are 3 separate alterations.  This is because each one is fairly intricate).
* The base/material can be done by a merchant separately or at the same time as one of the custom alterations.
*  It is up to the individual merchant if they wish to work on these items.

This mahogany cane is a part of the Gnomish Ingenuity collection.  It is Tier 2 of 2.

When stowed as a case: PUSH and TICKLE.
When deployed as a 105170: PUSH, LEAN, TICKLE, RAISE, DANCE, WAVE, PROD, and KICK.

It is possible to have the wood changed as part of a general alteration by any merchant willing to do so, but it must remain 'wood', so no materials with special properties. Collapsed 15/15/15: a gleaming/mahogany/case
Collapsed Long:
Collapsed Show:
Deployed 15/15/15: a gleaming/mahogany/cane
Opened Long:
Opened Show:

Cloth: leather
The mahogany cane will cost 1,000,000 coins.

This item allows you to transfer its appearance onto another compatible worn item by using the TRANSFER verb.  Hold this item in one hand and the target item in your other.  You must repeat the command within 30 seconds to confirm.

Bloodstone Jewelry

Tier 2:  Augmented Recovery
Grants enhancive attributes of +4 health, +2 mana, and +1 stamina recovery per tier.
Tier 3:  Vivacity
Activated ability to regain 20% of health, 10% of stamina, or 5% of mana every 2 seconds for 10 seconds.
- BESEECH pendant (HEALTH / STAMINA / MANA)

- SPIN:  Initiate the transfer of wounds for a second time to transfer the wounds back early.

Attacks deal an additional amount of concussion damage, occasionally overflowing to cause Major Bleed.

- PINCH: Toggle whether to enable the overflow capability.
The bloodstone pendant can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.
Alteration Guidelines
This item has not been locked to a final wear location and therefore may not be altered.

~*~ Moth Cloaks ~*~

This cloak is a butterfly/moth cloak with several randomizing points to create multiple unique looks with a single PUSH.  It is Tier 5 out of 5, and it is set to the moth setting.  It is set to NOT rotate with day/night changes.  You can APPROVE to toggle this setting.
The cloak features an encumbrance reduction (3x/day, 15 minutes each RUB, resets at midnight server time.  There are 3 charges left today.
Utilities:
* APPROVE:  rotates through "moth only," "butterfly only," or "adjust with day/night"
* CLEAN:  will clear the selected, stored look
* POKE: takes your randomized look and saves it in 1 of the 2 available stored slots
* PUSH - replaces your randomized look
* TURN - rotates through all saved looks (current randomized look, any stored randomized looks, the custom look, if applicable)
* RUB - activates the encumbrance reduction.
Unlocked Fluff Verbs:  observe, tickle, eat, flip, hug, raise, bow, curtsy, brush, touch, and wave
*  WAVE has some "drama llama" options for you!  Try WAVE CLOAK WITH (anger, drama, joy, mystery, or sorrow)
Alterations:
* Base:  must be simple, as it carries across all looks.  The noun must be in the hooded cloak family.
* Material:  must be a type of cloth.  This carries across all looks.
* Colors cannot be referenced in the base or material fields, as colors change based on the settings.
* Custom settings:  The alter points must be provided in this specific order:

** "butterfly adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing markinglocation^special*moth adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing marking location^special
** The total character count must be 511 or less
** Moth/Butterfly Adjective alter point must be 15 characters or less.  No a/an needed.
** See the wiki for in-depth information and examples at https://gswiki.play.net/Moth_Cloak
* Custom Look 1 (Butterfly):  You can provide a SHOW for your custom setting.  It cannot contradict the alter points selected for the custom settings.
* Custom Look 2 (Moth):  Same as butterfly, but for the moth version.

* Doing a custom setting is 1 alteration service, as is each custom look (so a custom setting, butterfly look, and moth look are 3 separate alterations.  This is because each one is fairly intricate).
* The base/material can be done by a merchant separately or at the same time as one of the custom alterations.
*  It is up to the individual merchant if they wish to work on these items.

-- Animalistic Totem --
This fetish is an item that holds the spiritual essence of an animal.  The essence can be gained from animal-like creatures, familiars, animal companions, or Animalistic Spirit items.
==Features==
* Spiritual Essences [5 out of 5 Slots Unlocked]
POINT the fetish at an appropriate animal-like creature, familiar, animal companion, or Animalistic Spirit item to have the fetish absorb some of the creature's essence.
If you have more than one spiritual essence slot unlocked, you can use TURN on the fetish to switch between the stored essences.
* Ambient Messages [ON - PROD to toggle]
While you are wearing the fetish, the spiritual essence currently chosen will make itself known every so often with ambient messaging.  You can use PROD to quiet the spirit at any time.
* Animalistic Decoration

You can PUSH Foraged Items, feathers, bones/teeth, skins, and other small items into the fetish and change its long description (the portion after the noun only).  Visit any willing merchant to change how each decoration type looks.  You can then PULL the fetish to remove the item at any time.

While holding something made of metal, wood, or bone in one hand, you can ADD to the fetish to change its base material.  CLEAN it to return it to how it looked initially.  WARNING: Materials used to change the fetish's base material are lost forever, so be sure you are happy with what you choose.
* Accent Material Change [Unlocked]

Once unlocked, you can then TWIST the fetish to focus on the accent material instead of the base material, allowing ADD to change the fetish's article.  You can use CLEAN, as well, while focused on the accent material to return the fetish to its original article.
Once an accent material has been added, you can use FLIP to adjust the article to different styles based on that material.
* Movement Styles [Unlocked -] OFF, use SPIN to select a style.]
When unlocked, you can allow the spiritual essence inside the fetish to affect how you look when you move from room to room.  SPIN will select a style, while COVER will toggle the feature off.
* Wear Location Change [Unlocked]
When unlocked, you can use FOLD on the fetish to switch between pin, wrist, and neck-worn locations.
* Bestial Power [Unlocked - T5 of 5,] Bestial Block.]  (Flares: ON, RUB to toggle)
When unlocked, the spiritual essence inside the fetish can help you passively in combat.  Only one of four paths can be chosen, and this cannot be changed once unlocked.
Abilities happen at a standard flare rate during combat if there are enough charges available.
Animalistic Endurance (Defensive) - +2 crit padding per tier.
Bestial Block (Defensive) - +3 DS/+2 TD per tier
Shifting Strike (Offensive) - +3 AS/+2 CS per tier
Feral Ferocity (Offensive) - +2 crit weighting per tier
The ability is fueled by skins from creatures, and up to 500 charges can be stored.
* Fluff Actions [Unlocked, T2 of 2.]
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations are fine, though the noun must be "idol", "totem", or "fetish".
* The adjective field should contain the material the fetish is made of.
* This fetish cannot accept a show description.

* Any willing merchant can change the designs for when feathers, bone/teeth, flowers, gems, bugs/sea creatures, or miscellaneous items are PUSHed into the fetish.  These work much like Veolas, but the only part of the description you can customize is the part after the noun.
* Any willing merchant can change the color of the different spiritual essences.
==Usage==

You will find that you can use the following verbs: POINT (attune to a creature), ADD (add a material), PUSH (add a decoration), PULL (remove a current decoration), CLEAN (set material back to default), PROD (toggle ambient messages), TWIST (change between material and accent), FLIP (change accent design once accent is ADDed), TURN (change spiritual essence selected), SPIN (change movement style), COVER (toggle off movement style), FOLD (change wear location), PRAY, WAVE (targeted/untargeted), TOUCH, POKE, DROP/PUT (feed skins), RUB (toggle flares on/off).
You can TOSS the fetish at a creature/object to send it in for review as a possible spiritual essence source.

raw: The yoke is constructed of layers of stormy grey silk and looks like it will span the shoulders and taper down the front of the torso.  One row of three faceted sigils form the yoke's central design, with each ensconced in its own gold setting.  At the moment, all of the sigils appear dull and lifeless.

Analysis of a stormy grey sigil-adorned yoke inset with golden circles indicates the creator has provided the following information:

Looking over the yoke and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/sigil-adorned/baldric or yoke".  This means the item's article CAN be changed.  Only "baldric" and "yoke" are valid as nouns, and the adjective of "sigil-adorned" is unalterable.  Also, the allowed wear-locations are shoulder-worn for baldrics and front-worn for yokes.  So if your alteration involves changing the noun, realize the wear-location MUST BE changed also.

NOTE-1:  The script's description of the yoke refers to it as "Constructed of layers of (color) (material)..." and bearing "...rows of faceted sigils...," so keep that in mind if you request an alteration.  The material and color of the yoke CAN be changed.  This item cannot accept a SHOW description, since the script already utilizes that field.
The color that the charged sigils glow CAN be changed.  It must be no longer than fifteen characters.
If you were to play with the sigil-adorned yoke, then you'd find that you can analyze, wear, remove, clench, push, and rub it.  RUB releases/casts a charge previously stored from a black crystal.
NOTE-2:  This yoke will ONLY accept charges from treasure-found crystals.
This is a Tier 1 yoke, with four tiers in total.  This yoke is sold OTS with one tier unlocked.
SCRIPT NAME: Sigil Adorned Baldric
This yoke CANNOT be deepened at all.
The sigil-adorned yoke will cost 90,000 coins.

raw: Designed with practicality in mind, the chatelaine offers both utility and elegance.  Anchored by a meviriel-framed narwhal hook plate, several finely crafted iridescent glass-beaded chains hold essential tools.  Among them are a pastel-tinted velvet scissor sheath and a cloud-painted leather nail file sheath, ensuring quick access and secure storage.  Dangling from a length of chain is a teacup-sculpted clip that is intended to house a thimble, while a teadragon-shaped evirissia eyeglass case keeps spectacles conveniently within reach.  Additional rings and chains are fashioned to secure a keyring while a small, metallic lobster claw clip is engineered to support a single key.

Fresh from the Coven's Chatelaines.

file, eyeglasses, glasses, key, key ring, scissors, and/or spectacles

It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of obsidian, an unusual material.  This material cannot be dyed.
Analysis of a glossy obsidian knife indicates the creator has provided the following information:
-- Scrimshaw Knife--
This obsidian knife lets you take bones, antlers, horns, fangs, and teeth and turn them into Weaveable Items.  You can carve designs into them as well.

If unlocked, it can also let you harvest bones, claws/talons, antlers/horns, and hooves from certain creatures.  The resulting items can either be Weaveable or skins that can be used in sheath-making.
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations to the 15/15/15, long and/or show of this obsidian knife are fine.  It needs to follow dagger-base alteration guidelines.

* Custom Weaveable Item slots are meant for the adjective of the created item.   They cannot be longer than 15 characters and should describe how the item is designed, such as a shape, a pattern, a carving style, or the like.  It should feasibly be something that a knife should be able to do to bone (so no colors).

* Custom Weaveable Bead slots are meant to affect the article (first 15) of the created beads.  They cannot be longer than 15 characters and must include a or an.  This should be something feasible you could affect on the beads with a knife, such as a shape, a pattern, a texture, etc., but no colors.

* Custom Hairstick slots require the full long description for the hairsticks.  The 15/15/15 of the created hairsticks is always going to be 'a pair of <material> hairsticks' and the custom should not contradict this.  You are able to include placeholders for: hairstick material and the full name of the bone used to make the hairsticks.

* Custom Lock Mastery clasp slots expect to be provided the noun of the created clasp.  They cannot be longer than 15 characters and should feasibly be something you can clasp a container with.  Only the noun should be provided - no material or color.
==Features==

This obsidian knife has access to the following verbs: WAVE (target a creature or object to use its likeness in designs), CARVE (carve/transform the item in your other hand), TURN (change the design of the item created through CARVE), SPIN (change what type of item CARVE turns things into), POKE (turn a claw/talon/hoof skin into a Weaveable object), FLIP (change article of Weaveable Item or Lock Mastery clasp), POINT (target a dead creature for potential deboning), TWIST (change targeted bone), CUT (remove bone from targeted creature), CLENCH (switch between getting a Weavable bone or a skin-type bone).
You can INSPECT the knife to get some information on how the next item created by CARVE will potentially appear.
Additionally, you can GAZE at the knife to view any custom settings you have applied.
Custom Weaveable Item Adjectives: 2 of 10 Unlocked
Custom Weaveable Bead Articles - 1 of 10 Unlocked
Custom Hairsticks Designs - 2 of 10 Unlocked
Custom Lock Mastery Clasp Nouns - 1 of 10 Unlocked
You can tell that the knife is as light as it can get.
The obsidian knife will cost 14,000,000 coins.

This is a tier 1 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Ronan
Deity Primary Color:              Night black
Deity Secondary Color:            Silver
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready

Analysis of a kaajkur scorched with dragonscale patterning indicates the creator has provided the following information:
--------- VIEW FROM A STAG SADDLES - ANALYZE INFO  ---------
This kaajkur is a View From a Stag saddle meant for use with "cervid" mounts.
Verb Sets active on this kaajkur:
*Verb Set 1:  DROP/PUT, GET, MOUNT (with styles), and DISMOUNT (with styles).
*Verb Set 2:  ATTEND, NUDGE, PULL, RUB, LEAN.
*Verb Set 3:  TILT, RAISE, TOUCH, CLENCH, PUSH
MOUNT styles -- MOUNT {STYLE} {target cervid} -- that are valid for this kaajkur's current setup are:  RIGHT; LEFT; POMMEL; MANE; JUMP; GRACE-L; GRACE-R
DISMOUNT styles -- DISMOUNT {STYLE} -- that are valid for this kaajkur's current setup are:  POMMEL; MANE, JUMP, SLIDE, GRACE-L, GRACE-R

The kaajkur can have various accessories added to it, if they were made specifically for a kaajkur:  a saddle pad, a saddle blanket, and either bells or trim.  If you have an accessory, you will need to hold both items and SLAP the saddle to add it; to remove an accessory, PRY for bells/trim, and PINCH or PINCH KAAJKUR WITH {PAD|BLANKET} for pad/blanket.  Some accessories change the long description.  This kaajkur currently has NO accessories attached.
--------- ALTERATION INFORMATION ---------

The noun cannot change.  So what can you do?  Any merchant may alter the article, adjective, and/or long description of the kaajkur.  They can also add a show description that will append to the hard-coded LOOK.  All alterations must be in keeping with the saddle's style (see below).  It is also recommended that you avoid show descriptions that rely on the long description being present because accessories can temporarily change the long description.
Note that some aspects of the LOOK are hard-coded (such as the length of the stirrups) and cannot currently be modified by a merchant.

This saddle's style (which is not currently eligible to be changed to another style) is set to kaajkur (Finnian).  For alteration purposes, keep the following in mind:  Its pommel is low-rise (doesn't really jut up vertically), and the cantle is what you'd expect from a "normal" saddle.  The stirrups are loose (no flaps).  It utilizes a billet and buckle girth type system for saddling.  It will usually include a pad or not use anything underneath at all.  It is somewhat light compared to other saddle styles.
The kaajkur will cost 5,000,000 coins.

raw: A pyrographed ghostwood auction block cannot store anything inside of it at all.  It also appears that a fairly small amount can be stored on the block.

Analysis of a pyrographed ghostwood auction block indicates the creator has provided the following information:
The auction block can be used as a tool and prop for setting up your own auctions and raffles.
The auction block is UNLOCKED to run raffles.
Alteration Guidelines:
The auction block can be altered freely as long as it still reflects being some sort of flat container with an interior and flat upper surface for displaying items for examination.
A gavel is used for messaging which can also be altered, but it must remain a "gavel" and cannot have a long or show.
The two raffle table props, the tickets, and barrel, can also be altered.  However, they, too, must keep the noun "tickets" and "barrel" and cannot have shows or longs.
Usage:
To run an auction: PUT the prize(s) (if desired) on the auction block for your customers to INSPECT and ANALYZE.
PUSH the auction block to toggle between runner-up and non-runner up modes.
BID <amount> block to set the starting bid amount.
POUND the block to begin bidding!
Bidders should BID <amount> block to up their bids.
POKE the block to announce the current bid and progress through once, twice, three times.
POUND the block to end bidding.
The winning bidder will get five minutes to return with a note large enough to cover their bid, after which DROPping it in the block will give them the prize(s) you have placed on top (if any).
To run a raffle, PULL the auction block to place tickets and a raffle barrel on top of the auction block.
PUSH the auction block to toggle between one ticket per customer or multiple tickets allowed.
TURN the auction block to select which line of credit to store your raffle proceeds in.
WRITE ticket;prize <description> to set the description on the tickets.
WRITE ticket;price # to set the cost of each ticket.
Wait until tickets have been collected in the barrel.
Up to 99 tickets can be purchased.
SPIN the barrel to draw a name.
SPIN the barrel more times to draw more names.
If any tickets have been purchased, you must SPIN the barrel at least once before you can stop the raffle.
The list of winners can be reviewed by LOOKing at the tickets.
CLEAN the barrel after SPINning to reset the raffle.
Please note that for raffles, the winner will not automatically receive any prizes on the table.  You must deliver them manually.
The profit will be placed inside the block as a note you can extract later.
Try as you might, you cannot get a good sense of whether or not the block's pockets could get any deeper, but you can tell that the block is as light as it can get.
The auction block will cost 101,000,000 coins.
